sn1.42:3.2: Here and [sn1.47:2.4]() are the only places we find _upassaya_ used for general “monastic quarters” rather than specifically for nuns. It is one of several Jain terms used by bhikkhunīs, perhaps because several prominent early bhikkhunīs, such as Bhaddā Kuṇḍalakesā, converted from Jainism.
